newsitem.title: JAPAN: AIG, M'bishi Trust to set up trust firm in Japan.
newsitem.headline: AIG, M'bishi Trust to set up trust firm in Japan.

text.p: American International Group Inc (AIG) said on Friday its Japanese unit and Mitsubishi Trust & Banking Corp will jointly set up an investment trust management company in Japan.

AIG, a U.S.-based holding company of insurance businesses worldwide, will take a 70 percent stake in the new company, AIMIC Investment Management Ltd, while Mitsubishi Trust group plans to hold the remainder, it said in a statement.
AIG said it had applied to the Finance Ministry for authorisation to run an investment trust company, but it did not indicate any likely timing for the approval.
